escenas.prompt: Static camera with a very slow, subtle push-in toward the window seat. Empty, quiet living room on a hot sunny afternoon. A strong beam of sunlight pours through the left window onto the fluffy orange cat sleeping curled up on the window seat; the cat's ear twitches once and its fluffy tail flicks slowly. Tiny dust particles float in the sunbeam. The fireplace stays empty with no fire. The roller shades stay rolled up. Nobody in the room. Nothing else moves.

Static camera. Bright hospital corridor in afternoon light. The nurse in navy scrubs holds her phone low in front of her, taps the screen twice with her thumb, then relaxes her shoulders and smiles softly. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around. No camera movement.

Static camera, same living room. The white roller shades on the windows slowly and smoothly roll down to halfway, and the hot sunbeams on the floor and on the window seat gently fade into soft, cool, even daylight. The orange cat keeps sleeping curled up on the window seat in the same place and pose. Furniture, fireplace and TV stay exactly the same. Nobody in the room.

Static camera, medium shot of the window seat in soft cool shade. The fluffy orange cat stretches its front paws forward lazily, gives a big slow yawn, then curls back up comfortably and closes its eyes, content. The shade stays down, soft diffused light. Realistic cat movement and size. Nobody else. Nothing else moves.
